description: This file defines the PimReportData class, which implements report data retrieval and normalization for a PIM report within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with report generation services and manages search filter parameters.

classes.name: PimReportData
classes.description: A class responsible for providing report data for PIM reports, including normalization and metadata retrieval, using report generator services and filter parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with given filter parameters.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of ReportGeneratorService.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns normalized report data based on current filter parameters.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns metadata about the report, specifically the total data count.
